rules.rationale: This is the base equation of the runSpec scanner summary, packaging the accumulated components when no input characters remain.
This recurrence defines how the runSpec mathematical summary consumes a space while preserving scanner state and recording the last character.
This recurrence defines the runSpec summary case for an opening parenthesis by increasing depth and extending the current group.
This recurrence defines the runSpec closing-parenthesis case at zero depth, including the summary's totalized output and reset behavior.
This recurrence defines the runSpec closing-parenthesis case at depth one, completing the current group and resetting its accumulators.
This recurrence defines the runSpec nested closing-parenthesis case by decreasing depth and retaining the extended unfinished group.
This structural projection equation defines how stateDepth observes the depth component of the named scanner summary state.
This structural projection equation defines how stateCurrent observes the unfinished-group component of the scanner summary state.
This structural projection equation defines how stateOutput observes the completed-groups component of the scanner summary state.
This structural projection equation defines how stateLast observes the last-character component of the scanner summary state.
This entry equation defines separateSpec by initializing runSpec and projecting its completed-groups component.
